acceptance.behavior: The login recovery link opens /reset-password, which moves from a public request form to credential update only after a valid recovery link is exchanged.
The responsive recovery surface provides explicit request, verification, validation, error, and success states without browser alerts.
Supabase Auth durably replaces the recovery identity's password and the acceptance journey proves the new credential can establish a session.
Password recovery cannot select or change a role, and the existing durable profile continues to route the recovered identity to Mentor OS.
The acceptance spec writes the required exact-revision screenshots, trace, accessibility report, and PBOS result manifest.
One Playwright journey validates the real Supabase reset request and recovery link contract, durable credential update, authority routing, desktop, mobile, and accessibility.
Labeled fields, live status semantics, focus-visible controls, reduced motion, mobile overflow checks, and axe analysis cover the recovery workflow.
Email responses do not enumerate accounts, direct route access cannot update credentials, recovery credentials are verified, and password rules are enforced before update.
